about: A record with a string field bounded by the sce:max-size its schema declares, eight UTF-8 bytes: built whole from its <sce:set>s, written a field at a time from a literal, from a string variable and from a typed event payload. The bound counts UTF-8 bytes, not characters. A value past it fails as any assignment does: nothing is written, error.execution is raised (`errors` counts it) and the block ends, so the record is left as it was. Expected values are derived from the byte counts (e-acute 2, euro sign 3), not observed from a backend.

steps.note: eight ASCII bytes fit a bound of eight
2 + 3 + 2 = seven bytes in three characters fit
2 + 3 + 2 + 2 = nine bytes in four characters do not: the record is left as it was and error.execution is raised
a string variable of five bytes fits the field
the variable holds sixteen bytes, which its own bound admits
sixteen bytes do not fit a field of eight: the field is left as it was
a field of five bytes into a variable of sixteen
the payload replaces the record field by field
nine bytes do not fit: the label is read first, so the sensor stays 7 as well
a list of records holds a copy of the record as it stands, with its text
the record changes and the copy in the list does not
the loop reads the string field of each record it walks: the note is the last one's
the third copy fills the list
a full list takes no more: the list is left as it was and error.execution is raised
